official_source_finding.behavior: InterMask crops and processes the paired motion first, then invokes the frozen VQ encoder online inside every MGT forward pass.
official_source_finding.rejected_shortcut: Do not encode the uncropped full motion once and crop cached tokens: convolutional receptive fields make boundary tokens numerically different.

per_draw_choices: exclusive-endpoint crop to at most 300 raw frames
train.randomness: SHA256-derived draw seed; independent local Python and NumPy streams; no worker-global RNG dependence
train.output: two normalized float32 [300,262] motions plus processed length and caption

tokenization.policy: frozen paired HHC VQ encode after crop/process/pad, under eval and no_grad
tokenization.valid_token_length: floor(processed_length/4) to match released InterMask InterHuman transformer training and generation
tokenization.generation_length_bridge: call the unchanged HHC sampler with m_length=4*valid_token_length, never the unrounded processed frame length; its existing ceil(m_length/4) then reproduces the released InterMask floor(processed_length/4) exactly without changing Inter-X sampling
tokenization.architecture_specific_tail: paper architecture attends only floor(processed_length/4) code positions and requires no End token; the retained high-performing historical topology explicitly replaces the first invalid online-VQ tail code with END and the remainder with PAD, while loss remains restricted to valid code positions
tokenization.note: processed_length is at most 299, hence released floor division yields at most 74 valid tokens. Real VQ -> 75x2 training forwards for both paper and historical topologies, plus a 74x2 floor-length sample, are CPU-tested.

forbidden: test or val examples in MGT training
